header.removedNotice: This fursona has been removed by moderators and is only visible to you. If you have questions, appeal via the contact details in the footer.

basic.title: Basics
basic.name: Name
basic.bioHint: Shown in the "About" section of the share page. Line breaks are supported.

avatar.title: Avatar & main fursona
avatar.hint: In the gallery, click "Edit" → "Set as fursona avatar". Avatars are cropped to Pawfit's rounded shape.

rating.title: Content rating
rating.hint: When checked, the whole fursona is hidden from visitors and from users who haven't enabled adult content. Per-image NSFW flags are set separately at upload.

gallery.empty: No images yet. Upload front and back reference sheets and commissioned art. Kind and rating are required.

palette.title: Palette
palette.subtitle: Drag the handle on the left to reorder · the share page follows this order
palette.empty: No colors yet. Add main fur, belly, eyes… so artists can copy them in one click.

tags.title: Fursona tags
tags.subtitle: Added automatically when posting (Phase 2)
tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter, e.g. long tail, heterochromia
tags.hint: Used for browsing and search. Species, build and age group are all worth filling in. {n} / {max}

privacy.title: Who can see this fursona

hints.public: Shown on your profile; anyone can view it.
hints.unlisted: Only people with the link can view it. Hidden from your profile and search.
hints.private: Only you can see it. The share link is disabled automatically.

privacy.friendsHint: Available once the friends system launches.
privacy.note: Individual images can override privacy in the gallery. Remember to hit "Save" in the top right when you're done.

delete.title: Delete fursona
delete.warning: Deletes all original images and derived versions. The share link stops working immediately. This can't be undone.

notify.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

share.title: Share link
share.privateNotice: This fursona is currently "Private", so its share link is disabled. It comes back once you switch to Public or Link only.
share.watermark: Use watermarked images on the share page
share.regenerateAsk: The old link stops working immediately. Continue?
share.regenerateNote: Regenerating invalidates the old link immediately
share.ogNoImage: The preview uses the first SFW image in the gallery; there's none available yet.
share.empty: No share link yet. Once created, paste it into Discord or Twitter or send it to an artist — they'll see the full reference and palette.

notify.regenerated: Link regenerated. The old URL no longer works
notify.watermarkOn: Watermark enabled. Generating watermarked versions of existing images
notify.revoked: Link disabled. The old URL no longer works
